|translation='''Title:''' Leia.

'''Lore:'''
Adopted daughter of Alderaan’s governor and first chairman. She became a political leader at a young age. She joined the Rebellion in opposition to the cruelty of the Emperor’s edicts.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore refers to the cruelty of the Emperor’s edicts.
